acceptance: `build` writes a deterministic zip of exactly the listed payload, every member named `<original path>.txt` with the original bytes, a manifest of revision, paths and sizes, and stops with no zip on a missing file, a forbidden file or a secret-like value. (B01, B02, B03, B04, B08)

The package carries the five instruction and restore files, the Copilot prompt with every restoration rule, and a `restore.py` that validates paths and sizes, refuses an existing destination, restores exact bytes into a new folder and installs nothing, stopping with nothing written on a bad member. (B05, B06, B07)

`verify` restores the package into a clean directory, compares every file with its source and checks the zip, and `VERIFICATION.txt` records only what was actually checked and what remains for the client environment; the payload holds the nine skill folders (the four lead tracker skills with their golden fixtures) and no tool or Node test. (B02, B09, B10)
